programme.title: CatDog

programme.title: CatDog

programme.title: CatDog

programme.title: CatDog

programme.title: CatDog

programme.desc: 'S8/E2 - Mini Moke'. Designed as an off-road army car, the Mini Moke soon became a civilian cult classic, so this should be a winner. Will Edd and Mike agree on anything and get the job done?

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: 'S8/E3 - Range Rover'. Mike buys a bargain Range Rover P38 and Edd sets about mending it. They head to the wilds of Exmoor to give the car a final test drive before searching for a buyer.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: 'S7/E9 - Volvo P1800S'. The team can't wait to get hold of a Volvo P1800 but the problem is, these cars are rare and Mike can only find a single car that's in budget. Will it be good enough?

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: 'S7/E10 - Subaru Impreza WRX'. Mike finds a clean WRX at a good price. Mike decides to make it stand out by making it go faster and look better. Edd has plenty of ideas on how to do both!

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: 'S6/E12 - Denali Lift, Bugatti Chop'. After Ekstensive finished his 1969 MGC, John Cena comes to the shop with 1937 Bugatti Type 57 parts. Bill surprises John with a daring design choice.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: 'S5/E1 - Jeep Splits And Foreign Whips'. Bill and the team split a 1960 Willys Jeep into four pieces to make it longer and wider. Plus, a 1998 AMG G-Wagon gets overhauled.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: 'S5/E2 - Mom-Ster Truck'. After pro wrestler and actor John Cena makes a surprise appearance at the shop, Bill and the guys begin to customise John's small 1969 MGC to be a perfect fit.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: 'S5/E3 - From The Ground Up'. Bill designs a clever cantilever suspension system for a 1928 Ford Rat Rod. And, an old friend needs help with the new tires on his 1975 Chevrolet C-10.

programme.title: World's Biggest Shipbuilders
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Mega Yards'. In the South Korean shipyards of Okpo and Sungdong, two teams are building a giant tanker - the Maersk Tangier - along with the world's biggest jack-up rig - the XLE4.

programme.title: Ultimate Ninja Challenge
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Prepared For Battle'. Nine warriors must undertake a series of survival missions in the freezing regions of Canada for 24 days according to the laws of the Ninja.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Born Survivor
programme.desc: 'S4/E4 - Texas'. In western Texas, Bear falls to earth from a bi-plane to lock horns with the parched Chihuahuan Desert. He traverses through deep gorges and takes on a diamond-back rattlesnake.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: 'S4/E13 - Winter Is Here'. As the first snow falls, the Browns make a risky attempt to move their shelters closer to the barn. Noah prepares his pregnant wife,Rhain, for her first bush winter.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: 'S4/E15 - The Wolfpack vs. The Wolf'. The Browns raise the defences when they find grisly evidence that a new predator is stalking the ranch. And, Gabe builds an apartment for him and Raquell.
